notes: ① 面板新增「同步内容」卡：把同步到云端的十组内容逐组列出，默认全勾；组和单项都能取消勾选。取消后推送不再抓、拉取不再还原，重新勾上就继续同步（推送与拉取共用同一份勾选）。② 这张卡是只读优先的：打开时复选框全是灰的，点「修改」才解锁勾选，改完点「保存」才写进文件，点「取消」丢弃这次改动。不再一点就改。③ 展开明细改成点当前那一行（再点收起），原来的「明细 / 收起」按钮已去掉。④ 勾选记在本机 ~\.dsh\config-sync-scope.json，不进仓库；文件只留与默认不同的项，删掉即恢复全勾。⑤ 卡里另有开关「取消勾选时顺手删掉云端副本」，默认关闭：关着时云端那份留着、重新勾上立刻继续；打开后取消勾选会真的删掉仓库里的对应目录（推送时删，另一台机器拉不到），删除不可恢复。⑥ 「本机 profile」是必需内容，面板上标「必需」且勾不动：仓库里缺 profile\package.json / cordis.patch.yml 时 apply 会直接报错退出，host-contract.json 又是两端版本校验。手改 config-sync-scope.json 把它关掉也无效，两侧都按开启处理。
notesEn: (1) New "Sync content" card: the ten groups that sync to the cloud are listed individually, checked by default, and both a group and each item can be unchecked. Unchecked content is no longer captured on push and no longer restored on pull; tick it again and syncing resumes (push and pull share one file). (2) The card is read-only first: every checkbox opens greyed out, "Edit" unlocks them, "Save" writes the file and "Cancel" throws the change away — no more editing by a single click. (3) Expanding items is done by clicking the row itself (click again to collapse); the old Details / Hide button is gone. (4) Choices live on this machine in ~\.dsh\config-sync-scope.json and are never committed; the file stores only what differs from the default, so deleting it restores "everything checked". (5) One more switch, "Also delete the cloud copy when unchecked", off by default: while off the cloud copy stays and re-ticking resumes immediately; when on, unchecking really deletes the matching folder from the repo on the next push, and that deletion cannot be undone. (6) "Local profile" is required: the panel marks it required and greys the checkbox out. Without profile\package.json / cordis.patch.yml in the repo the pull stops with an error, and host-contract.json is the version check between the two machines. Editing config-sync-scope.json to turn it off does not help either — both sides treat it as on.
